app_info.subtitle: Control your SEVEN browser
app_info.description: SevenEx connects ChatGPT or Codex to the signed-in user's selected SEVEN browser. It checks browser availability, queues one browser command through the SEVEN Bridge, and reads the result while account, workspace, session, and device routing remain server-side.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads connection and compatibility status for the signed-in user's selected browser without changing browser or external state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, submit, or modify public or third-party internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues a browser command that may navigate, type, click, upload, submit, or otherwise change browser and external state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Browser commands may interact with third-party websites and can change externally visible state depending on the requested mission.
justifications.destructive_justification: A browser mission can include irreversible or destructive actions on external sites, so the tool is conservatively marked destructive.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the stored result for one previously queued command and does not execute another browser action.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish or change any external system; it only retrieves an existing command result.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Check whether the selected SEVEN browser is connected.
test_cases.user_prompt: Verifique se meu navegador SEVEN está conectado.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports connection and compatibility status without asking for a device code.

test_cases.description: Queue a structural vision command for the selected browser.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use meu navegador SEVEN para ler estruturalmente a página atual.
test_cases.expected_output: Queues one policy-compliant vision command and returns a commandId for later result retrieval.

test_cases.description: Read the result of a previously queued browser command.
test_cases.user_prompt: Busque o resultado do comando de navegador que acabou de ser enviado.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current stored result state for the command without internally polling or launching another browser action.

test_cases.description: Run a safe browser mission through the managed tab policy.
test_cases.user_prompt: Abra uma pesquisa em uma aba SEVEN em segundo plano e leia o título da página, sem tirar meu foco.
test_cases.expected_output: Queues a mission that respects background-first managed-tab policy and returns a commandId.

test_cases.description: Detect an incompatible or offline Operator before sending work.
test_cases.user_prompt: Confira se minha extensão SEVEN está pronta para receber comandos agora.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports whether the selected Operator is connected and compatible, including an update-required state when appropriate.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a Google Drive-only request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Liste os arquivos recentes do meu Google Drive sem usar o navegador.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: SevenEx should not be invoked because direct Drive workflows are outside its browser transport scope.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a general knowledge question.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explique a diferença entre WebSocket e HTTP polling.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because no SEVEN browser action or status is needed.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a request that only needs text rewriting.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Reescreva este parágrafo de forma mais curta e clara.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the task does not require browser control.
